articles.title: Switzerland says cancelling US Patriot missile system order an option
articles.summary: Switzerland is withholding payments to the United States for its Patriot missile system order, demanding binding delivery dates from Washington. This highlights potential procurement challenges and supply chain issues in international defence contracts. The standoff underscores complexities countries face in acquiring critical defence assets and managing bilateral defence agreements, impacting military readiness and international strategic partnerships.

articles.title: The 9 best movies coming to Netflix in April
articles.summary: Netflix is expanding its streaming catalog by adding the 'Mission: Impossible' film series, from the original up to 'Rogue Nation.' A selection of horror movies will also become available. The platform highlights 'Roommates,' starring Chloe East and Sadie Sandler. This update significantly diversifies entertainment options for subscribers.
